description.fun: A giant long-necked beast, part sauropod and part Raikou, with its head quite literally in the clouds. It's said to cover the sky in dark clouds and call down lightning with its neck, and the bolts from its fur are rumoured to disintegrate anything. It briefly became a hot topic when a paranormal magazine called it Raikou's ancestor, and it may nod to Brontosaurus, the 'thunder lizard'.
description.guide: An Electric and Dragon-type Paradox Pokémon introduced in The Indigo Disk, said to be either an ancient relative of Raikou or a version of it from a parallel timeline. It resembles a long-necked sauropod and calls down lightning on its foes. Its counterpart is Iron Crown.
description.tagline: A long-necked thunder beast with its head in the clouds
